Sub: Retirement of Mr. Noel N. Tata as Director and Vice - Chairman
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI LODR), we wish to inform you that,
in accordance with the Tata Group Governance Guidelines, Mr. Noel N. Tata (DIN:
00024713) will retire from the office of Non - Executive, Non - Independent Director and Vice -
Chairman of the Company, with effect from 12th November 2026.

filings.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Directorate
filings.detail: Appointment of Mr. Rajesh Varrier (DIN: 00105765) as an Additional Director (Non- Executive Independent Director) on the Board of the Federal Bank Limited
filings.pdf_text:
Sub: Appointment of Mr. Rajesh Varrier (DIN: 00105765) as an Additional Director ( Non – Executive
Independent Director ) on the Board of The Federal Bank Limited .
We wish to inform you that based on the recommendations of the Nomination, Remuneration, Ethics
and Compensation Committee and pursuant to the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 and the Reserve Bank
of India (Commercial Banks - Governance) Directions, 2025, the Board of Directors of the Bank at its
meeting held today i.e., Friday, October 16, 2026 has approved the appointment of Mr. Rajesh Varrier
(DIN: 00105765) as an Additional Director (Non – Executive Independent Director) on the Board of the
Bank, for a period of three consecutive years with effect from October 16, 2026.
Mr. Rajesh Varrier is not related to any of the Directors or Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank.
Annexure – A
Name of the Director Mr . Rajesh Varrier
Reason for change viz. appointment, re - appointment, resignation, removal, death or otherwise;
Appointment of Mr. Rajesh Varrier (DIN: 00105765) as an Additional Director (Non – Executive
Independent Director) on the Board of the Bank.
Annexure B – Brief Profile of Mr . Rajesh Varrier (DIN: 00105765)
Mr. Rajesh is Cognizant's President, Global Operations, and Chairman & Managing Director of Cognizant
India. He leads the company's software engineering group and operational model globally in addition to
overseeing the company's presence in India.
Prior to joining Cognizant in September 2024, Mr. Rajesh served as EVP, Head of Global Services and
Infosys Americas, as well as Global Head of Infosys' Digital and Microsoft businesses. His previous roles at
Infosys included SVP of Digital Experience and Microsoft business. Prior to that, Rajesh was CIO and Digital
Officer for Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance.
Mr. Rajesh holds a bachelor's degree in physics, and a postgraduate degree in computer engineering from
the University of Mumbai.

Sub: Change s in Senior Management
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations,
2015 (SEBI LODR), we wish to inform you that the following officials of the Company ha ve been categorized
under S enior M anagement Personnel (SMP) of the Company, pursuant to promotions.
Sr.No. Name and Designation
1. Dr. C Jayakumar, Senior Vice President & Head - Corporate Human Resources
2. Mr. Suresh Kumar Narang, Senior Vice President & IC Head - CarbonLite Solutions IC &
Chief Executive – LMB
3. Mr. S Ramkumar, Senior Vice President & IC Head - Transportation Infrastructure IC
4. Mr. Sriraman T, Senior Vice President & IC Head - Residential, Commercial Buildings &
Factories IC
Annexure A
1 Reason for change viz. resignation
Promoted as Senior Vice President effective July 1, 2026, in terms
of promotion circular s issued on October 6, 2026
2 Date of appointment & term of appointment
D r. C Jayakumar is an existing employee of the Company. D r. Jayakumar joined the Company on May 4, 1988.
Mr. Suresh Kumar Narang is an existing employee of the Company. Mr. Narang joined
the Company as Project Director – Nabha Power on February 10, 2010.
3 Brief Profile Dr. C. Jayakumar is a distinguished HR leader with over 38 years of
rich and diverse experience in strategic HRM & organizational transformation. As the CHRO of
L&T Ltd., he has played a pivotal role in shaping the people agenda.
Mr. Suresh Kumar Narang, Sr. Vice President & Head – L&T Energy - CarbonLite Solutions,
has over four decades of experience across the power sector. As Chief Executive of
Nabha Power Ltd (2021 - 2026), he transformed the company into one of India's most
efficient supercritical thermal power plants.
Mr. S Ramkumar is an existing employee of the Company. Mr. Ramkumar joined the Company on July 24, 1991.
Mr. Sriraman T is an existing employee of the Company. Mr. Sriraman joined the Company on July 1, 1993.
Prior to this role, Mr. Ramkumar played a key role in developing L&T's Power Transmission business across
India, Oman, the GCC and Southeast Asia.
Mr. T. Sriraman joined L&T as a Graduate Engineer Trainee in 1992 and has over 34 years
of experience across diverse functions and business verticals within L&T Construction.
